snippet.title: Starfinder: Afterlight - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Gather your crew and venture into the Pact Worlds!
Sneak a peak into the world of Starfinder: Afterlight in our exclusive reveal teaser 🔥

Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG video game that brings Paizo’s beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Experience Starfinder 2E’s turn-based tactical combat and a story-driven narrative where choices matter.

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://bit.ly/3GQ12xc
Coming Soon to Kickstarter: https://bit.ly/4ocYj1o

Follow our channels to stay up-to-date with the news:
Official Site: https://www.epictellers.com/
X: https://x.com/epictellers
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/epictellers/
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/epictellers.bsky.social
